answer: Duplicate identities share one stake pool, so a sybil swarm needs N times the capital for N identities. Participants must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware ridge signature, and each epoch they post a basalt-sealed proof of unique work. Honest agents earn a haven rebate from slashed duplicate stakes, making forgery costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
